cards.back: We the Travellers — I When was the last time you went on a long trip?

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'We the Travellers – I'?
cards.back: Ask the elders who went with you to help you answer these questions.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'We the Travellers – I'?
cards.back: Human beings have always been interested in travelling.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'We the Travellers – I'?
cards.back: About a hundred years ago, there were far fewer vehicles than today.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'We the Travellers – I'?
cards.back: There were animal-drawn carts, cars, and trains.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'We the Travellers – I'?
cards.back: Long before this, thousands of years ago, people travelled long distances on foot or used animals to travel from one place to another.
